offset_unit: Unicode code points after UTF-8 decoding and universal-newline normalization (Python Path.read_text)

anchors.name: widget_stream_transport
anchors.fact: As wraps the request through _.us and sends method widgetStreamAssist.

anchors.name: thinking_request_container
anchors.fact: Selected thinkingLevel is placed in streamAssistRequest.generationSpec.thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel. The same constructor still sets modelId in assistGenerationConfig.

anchors.name: observed_level_ids
anchors.fact: Read params.supportedThinkingLevels[].id/name/description/disabled and defaultThinkingLevelId; ids are strings, not fixed LOW/HIGH literals.

anchors.name: model_extension_scope
anchors.fact: Select capabilities.extensions[] by the exact URI https://www.googleapis.com/gemini-enterprise/a2a/extensions/model/v1, then use its params.

anchors.name: agent_card_source
anchors.fact: The extension source is a2aAgentInfo.agentCard.capabilities.extensions; the detail path also parses a2aAgentDefinition.jsonAgentCard. This does not establish Business Argon support.

temperature_match_scope: MCP sampling/createMessage schema, not widgetStreamAssist generation settings
probe_gate: Require the target model/agent's observed enabled thinking-level id before a single opt-in generationSpec probe. Never guess an enum or replay the six rejected fields.
